verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Airbyte tracks state between runs. Incremental syncs pull only data changed since the previous sync, and CDC tracks the current position in database logs. That implies a cursor or checkpoint mechanism, but nothing shows interrupted syncs resuming mid-run or transient failures being retried automatically. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry of failed or transient sync attempts, explicit resume-from-checkpoint for interrupted syncs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
